First Contentful Paint (FCP) for all pages is also within an acceptable range, suggesting that the initial rendering of the page is happening quickly.

The "How It Works" page's failure in the web performance test highlights the need for a thorough investigation of potential issues such as large images, excessive scripts, or inefficient rendering. Addressing these issues will significantly improve the user experience.
It is recommended to continuously monitor and optimize web performance, especially for pages with higher load times, to ensure a smooth and fast user experience.
